messages:
Avery (AE): Kicking off a POC with FinDocs next week — want to lock success criteria, acceptance thresholds, and a 4-week timeline. They care about redaction + extractive summarization + search relevance for ~10k docs.
Priya Shah: Quick clarifying Qs — customer expects p95 latency < 300ms for single-turn generates, cost cap of $10k for the month, and extraction F1 > 0.92. Are those realistic on hosted?
Marco Ruiz (Solutions): Short answer: yes with constraints. With r-infer-large-v1 (quant) on hosted and aggressive prefix caching we can hit p95~250-300ms for 256-token responses. Cost depends on token mix; rough estimate: $0.0015-0.0020/gen-token after batching/caching gains.
Avery (AE): We need a concrete acceptance checklist we can put in the SOW. Can you draft evals/prompts and pass/fail criteria?
Marco Ruiz (Solutions): Will do. Proposal: three eval suites — (1) Redaction (200 examples), acceptance: precision >=0.95 AND recall >=0.90; (2) Summarization (200 examples), acceptance: ROUGE-L >=0.75 and human spot-check 90% OK; (3) Retrieval + RAG (100 queries), acceptance: MRR@5 >=0.6 and factuality error rate <2%. I'll upload the prompt CSV. Example prompt: "Redact PII from the following document:
<document>"
Janelle - SRE: Operational asks: 99.5% uptime for the POC window, canary rollout plan, and an automatic fallback to a smaller model when we detect sustained tail latency or GPU OOMs. Also need audit events for KMS usage.
Priya Shah: Customer prefers hosted but will only sign if KMS + SOC2 attestation are present. They also want a monthly trial cap of $10k and a daily burn alert.
Marco Ruiz (Solutions): Pricing sketch for POC: enterprise hosted baseline $5k/month (enterprise features + KMS) + usage. Example math for 4-week POC: expected gen tokens 500k -> at $0.0015/token = $750; embeddings 100k @ $0.0006 = $60. Total ~$5.8k including baseline, well under the cap. I'll make a conservative estimate and include a buffer.
Avery (AE): Need an ops runbook snippet to include in the SOW (canary steps, rollback).
Marco Ruiz (Solutions): Runbook snippet I'll include:
```
route: canary
percentage: 5
duration: 24h
alerts:
  - cost_burn_absolute: 5000  # alert if spend > 50% of monthly cap for POC
  - latency_p95_ms: 300
fallback:
  model: r-infer-medium-v1
  when: sustained_p95>500ms for 10m
```
Priya Shah: Security questionnaire note — they'll send a VendorSec PDF that requires confirmation on HSM-backed keys and audit retention. sec-bot, confirm HSM/KMS capabilities?
sec-bot: KMS/HSM support available via enterprise add-on. Audit logs exported to CloudWatch/S3 for retention. Link: https://redwood.example.com/security/kms (internal docs).
Janelle - SRE: QuickDedicated check: Dedicated will definitely tighten latency tail but needs a 2-week lead for capacity. For the 4-week POC hosted is fastest; if they require strict latency SLOs we should propose Dedicated for production. I'll validate exact p95 deltas and post numbers in #eng-sre by Monday.
Avery (AE): Next actions: Marco -> upload 200 eval prompts + conservative cost estimate by EOD Friday; Janelle -> Dedicated feasibility and p95 matrix by Monday; Priya -> confirm receipt of VendorSec questionnaire when it arrives. I'll include the runbook snippet in the SOW draft. :thumbsup:
Priya Shah: Got it — I'll ask the customer for the questionnaire today.
Marco Ruiz (Solutions): On it. I'll put prompts in drive/fin-docs-evals and link back here.
Janelle - SRE: I'll copy results to sales thread and tag you all.
